prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE production reference sheet for the Toktogi 2D game. Match the already displayed C011 springtail reference in rounded low-poly cartoon forms, clean dark blue-gray edge definition, restrained surface texture, readable four-tone shading, matte natural green/brown palette (the plant must retain its natural color, not springtail white). Off-white background, uniform neutral light, orthographic multi-view panels: top, front, left, right, back, underside/detail, consistently same object, no perspective distortion, no scenery, no shadow crossing panels, no text on object. Labels outside object in English with asset ID. Broad simple forms suitable for editable low-poly Blender geometry. Do not add a springtail character. This is a reference sheet, not a runtime sprite. Subject: B09 An editable 3D reference for a compact underwater sediment tile: low irregular slab of gray-brown silt and clay, visible subtle horizontal sediment layers on sides, 6 rounded gravel pebbles and a few dark organic fragments scattered on top. No water plane, no animals, no plants, no biome diorama. A calm clean game background surface; sediment particle sizes and tile size are design choices, no physical scale claim.
style_input_delivery: Reference displayed in conversation; new-image call omitted explicit image-path arguments.
correction: 한 메시의 층과 자갈 6개를 모든 뷰가 공유한다. 생성 시트의 그림자와 갈색 명암은 별도 지오메트리로 복제하지 않는다.
selection_reason: 생물 명세의 큰 형태와 프로젝트 카툰 톤 참고. 실제 정투영·기관 수는 제작 계약과 Blender 출력이 우선한다.
license_note: 내장 생성 도구 산출물. 외부 사진·외부 모델을 복제하거나 새로 배포하지 않았다. 원자료의 법적 권리는 별도 검토하지 않았다.
